newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Oct consumer prices rise 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile Oct consumer prices rise 0.7 pct.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 0.7 percent last month against 0.8 percent in October last year, said the National Statistics Institute.
The institute said unemployment in the July-September quarter fell to 6.8 percent from seven percent in the June-August period.
Industrial production grew 1.4 percent in September against the same month last year, said the institute.
Industrial sales remained unchanged compared with September last year.
